report.explanation: Current telemetry shows no checkout errors: all sampled checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returned 200, and order metrics show 0 502s on /v1/orders. The only deployment record is baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, so it cannot establish a deployment-caused fault. The operator hypothesis is contradicted rather than supported; no bounded root cause is established.
missing_evidence: Error-level traces or logs showing failing checkout/order requests with status codes and error messages
Metrics for checkout and gateway services showing error rates over the incident window
Deployment history for order and checkout services covering the incident window, including any version change
Evidence of resource saturation (db pool, redis latency) correlated with failures
